title: Login with valid credentials establishes session
objective: Verify a seeded user can authenticate via POST /api/v1/auth/login and receives a session cookie with correct attributes.
preconditions: Stack running; seed user 'operator' exists with documented dev password.
steps: GET /api/v1/auth/csrf to obtain csrftoken cookie.
POST /api/v1/auth/login with JSON credentials and X-CSRFToken header.
Inspect response status, body, and Set-Cookie headers.
GET /api/v1/auth/me with the session cookie.
expected_result: Login returns 200 with user profile; Set-Cookie sessionid has HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure (non-local), and a session cookie is rotated; /auth/me returns 200 with id, display name, role, scopes, capability flags. Password or secrets never appear in any response.

title: Login with invalid credentials returns generic error
objective: Verify failed login gives a generic message that does not reveal whether the username exists, returns error envelope, and does not set a session cookie.
test_data: (a) valid username + wrong password; (b) non-existent username + any password
steps: POST /api/v1/auth/login with case (a). Record status, body, headers.
POST /api/v1/auth/login with case (b). Record status, body, headers.
Compare the two responses.
expected_result: Both return identical generic failure (401 with error envelope code AUTHENTICATION_FAILED or equivalent, message not distinguishing bad username vs bad password); no sessionid cookie set; response contains a correlation_id.

title: Logout invalidates session
objective: Verify POST /auth/logout terminates the session server-side.
steps: Confirm GET /auth/me returns 200.
POST /api/v1/auth/logout with CSRF header.
Retry GET /auth/me with the same cookie.
expected_result: Logout returns 200/204; subsequent /auth/me returns 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED; cookie cleared or invalidated.

title: Unauthenticated API access is rejected
objective: Verify protected endpoints return 401 without a session and do not leak data.
steps: GET /api/v1/assets without cookies.
GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary without cookies.
GET /api/v1/saved-views without cookies.
GET /api/v1/auth/me without cookies.
expected_result: All return 401 with error envelope (code AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED) and no resource data. Health endpoints /health/live and /health/ready remain 200 without auth and expose no sensitive data.

title: CSRF enforced on unsafe methods
objective: Verify mutating requests without a valid CSRF token are rejected even with a valid session.
steps: POST /api/v1/assets with valid payload and session cookie but no X-CSRFToken header.
Repeat with an incorrect X-CSRFToken value.
Repeat with correct X-CSRFToken from csrftoken cookie.
expected_result: Requests without/with wrong CSRF token return 403 (CSRF failure); request with correct token succeeds (201) or fails only on validation. No asset is created by the rejected requests.

title: UI sign-in flow with deep-link return
objective: Verify sign-in page flow: unauthenticated visit to a deep link redirects to /login?next=..., successful sign-in lands on the original target.
test_data: deep link /assets/<seed asset uuid>; operator credentials
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/assets/<uuid> unauthenticated.
Observe redirect to /login with next parameter.
Sign in with operator credentials.
Observe final landing page.
Sign out via profile menu; verify protected page access again redirects to login.
expected_result: Redirect to /login?next=/assets/<uuid>; after login user lands on the asset detail page (not a generic home); after sign-out, protected pages redirect to /login again. No private data visible while logged out.

title: Expired/invalid session handled with redirect to sign-in
objective: Verify that when the backend returns 401 mid-session, the SPA clears state and redirects to /login preserving the return URL, without displaying raw errors.
steps: Sign in via UI; navigate to /assets.
Corrupt or delete the sessionid cookie (dev tools or Playwright context).
Trigger a navigation or data fetch.
Observe app behavior.
expected_result: App redirects to /login?next=<current path>; a user-safe message is shown; no stack traces or raw exception text displayed; no stale private data rendered.

title: Login success/failure/logout write audit events
objective: Verify each auth event creates an AuditEvent with actor, action, timestamp (UTC), outcome, correlation ID.
preconditions: Admin access to audit query surface (DB or /admin/audit-events if delivered; else DB inspection via pytest).
test_data: one successful login, one failed login, one logout for 'operator'
steps: Record current audit event count.
Perform failed login, successful login, logout.
Query audit events for the three actions.
expected_result: Three new AuditEvent rows: login_failed (outcome=fail, no session), login_success, logout; each with timestamp UTC, actor identification (username for attempt), outcome, correlation_id; no password stored anywhere in the event payloads.

title: Login rate limiting / backoff
objective: Verify repeated failed logins trigger rate limiting per design §13.
preconditions: Stack running with default rate-limit config.
test_data: N+ rapid failed login attempts for one username (N = documented limit; use up to 30)
steps: Send repeated failed POST /auth/login attempts in quick succession.
Observe status codes across attempts.
expected_result: After the configured threshold, responses become 429 with error code RATE_LIMITED and retryable guidance; account is not permanently locked (or documented lockout applies); generic messages preserved.

title: Session fixation protection — cookie rotated on login
objective: Verify session ID changes upon authentication.
test_data: pre-login anonymous session cookie (if any), operator credentials
steps: GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and note any sessionid value set pre-login.
POST /auth/login with valid credentials.
Compare sessionid before and after login.
expected_result: sessionid value after login differs from any pre-login value (rotation on privilege change).
